title: E7: factory-wide probe validation sweep
description: Compile every curated factory DGen instrument/effect through the embedded path and probe-validate audio. Findings report, not a diff — good workflow fan-out. Completes the initial embedded version. Impl spec slice E7. Precondition: PR #40 (E6) merged.

title: Decision: sounds/ + samples/ project-path migration strategy
description: Existing projects pool-reference sounds/ and samples/ by path. Moving them out of the repo (T2) needs a project-path migration or resolve-time fallback chain. Decide before T2. Spec: content-tiers 7.2.

title: T1: AppPaths coverage for all content lookups
description: Every content lookup goes through AppPaths with ZERO behavior change: instrument_storage.rs (~10 relative INSTRUMENTS_DIR/EFFECTS_DIR sites), paths.rs init candidates, ui/ loads, presets, sample-assets. Also audit for runtime writes into factory content dirs (forbidden per content-tiers 4.1). Exit: grep-clean for relative content-path literals. Spec: content-tiers 5-6 slice T1.

title: S1: reader + resolution + sdf pilot
description: / qualifier split, module + import forms, % privacy warning, namespace-aware macro lookup, namespaced native registration; convert sdf-stdlib (module sdf) as acceptance test — all 34 consumers + Rust templates pass untouched. Module spec slices 1 + section 9.

title: S0: implicit eseq.vanilla module
description: Headerless files compile as module eseq.vanilla. Zero behavior change; vanilla-is-a-distro becomes literal. Module spec slice 0.

title: Module system: namespaces, hooks, override, packages
description: Spec: docs/module-system-spec.md rev 3. Slices S0-S5. defhook (spec 6) already BUILT.

title: Content tiers: directory system + user tier
description: Spec: docs/content-tiers-spec.md rev 1. Factory/user/package tiers, repo split into assets/, ~/.eseq.d, copy-on-write. T1-T2 are prerequisites for toolchain Phase 5.

title: Embedded dgen toolchain: ship it
description: Finish + ship the embedded toolchain. Parent spec: crates/sequencer/docs/embedded-dgen-toolchain-v0.1-spec.md; impl spec: crates/sequencer/docs/embedded-dgen-connector-impl-spec.md. D1-D2 + E1-E6 DONE (E6 = PR #40).

title: Phase 5: bundle, signing, notarization, clean-machine proof
description: App bundle layout (nested signed helpers DGenLisp/dgen-clang/ld64.lld), AppPaths Release arm activation, Developer ID + hardened runtime + disable-library-validation entitlement, notarization/stapling, clean-machine acceptance matrix (no Xcode/CLT). Release builds must ignore ESEQ_DGEN_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT. Parent spec Phase 5; content-tiers 3-5 are the layout source of truth.

title: T3b: bare-name -> tier-qualified instrument ids in projects
description: Projects reference instruments by bare name today. On first load after T3: resolve bare -> factory: if present there else user:, stamp qualified id on next save. Instruments do NOT shadow by name. Spec: content-tiers 4.1.

title: T3: user tier (~/.eseq.d + Application Support)
description: Create-on-first-run for App Support + ~/.eseq.d; HOME init candidate; load-path resolution (user modules -> packages -> factory). Coordinate with module slice S4 (eseq-mods.5) init inversion — init.lisp loads LAST. Spec: content-tiers 4 + slice T3.

title: T2: repo split into top-level assets/
description: git mv factory content (ui, instruments, effects, defmacros, midi-fx, presets, sample-assets, core eseqlisp lisp) into assets/; demos to crates/eseqlisp/examples/; projects/recordings/samples.db/sounds out of git into .local/; flip AppPaths Dev roots. One commit, mostly renames. Spec: content-tiers 3 + slice T2.

title: S4: init inversion + override registry
description: ~/.eseq.d/init.lisp loaded LAST; delete main.lisp ordering comments. Build override (module spec 6.1): VM::overrides registry checked at resolution BEFORE owning def, :around w/ late-bound original, remove-override, erroring override falls through to factory, %-private override warns. defhook already BUILT. Module spec slice 4.

title: S3: per-file module headers + registry auto-qualification
description: One file at a time; prefix families make renames mechanical; compat alias table during migration, deleted at end. Registry auto-qualification (defstate, :key FNV prefix, define-mode, late-bound string handlers capture module). Module spec slices 3 + section 5.

title: S2: split ui/main.lisp
description: main.lisp = load manifest + 4 modules in a trenchcoat; untangle 67 shared symbols w/ sequencer.lisp incl. back-edge cycle; param-mode gets an owning module. Must precede per-file headers. Module spec slice 2; see docs/big-file-split-plan.md.

title: Phase 4: single compilation service
description: Consolidate ~30 scattered compile_and_load* call sites into one service: structured diagnostics for agent retries, centralized cancellation. Parent spec Phase 4. Do when next touching agent-authoring UX.

title: T4: copy-on-write forking + packages dir
description: In-app fork-to-user-tier / revert-to-factory (per docs/instrument-fork-spec.md incl. param_index p-lock remap gotcha); ~/.eseq.d/packages/ scan; package = git repo mirroring factory layout, install v1 = git clone. Spec: content-tiers 4.0-4.1 + slice T4; module spec 8.

title: Remove legacy register-hook/clear-hooks clock-callback system
description: Deprecated for removal (module spec 6 naming note, locked 2026-08-11): mode.rs:93, app/effects.rs:242-283, HookUnit/register_control_hook. Independent of module slices; defhook owns the word hook.

title: S5: packages
description: Manifest format, load path, author-scoped names (alec/acid-tools), defcustom; generalize defmacro_library.rs. Module spec slice 5 + section 8; distribution story in content-tiers 4.0 (repo IS a package, git clone install).
